1.consolidated_definition: Comer algo a secas significa consumirlo sin acompañamientos o mezcla con otros alimentos.

reference_definitions: A puras, sin mixtura. “Se comió el aguacate a secas, como el gato.”

1.en_consolidated_definition: Eating something dry means consuming it without accompaniments or mixing with other foods.

en_definitions: Eating something dry means consuming it without accompaniments or mixing with other foods.
